title: AI Art Video-Surreal AI Scenes Animated With Higgsfield
description:
Another strange surreal scenes video. I wanted to try some of these weird scenes using #Higgsfield AI and it continues to impress me with its movements and quality. Song made in #Suno and images made using #midjourney 

#fyp #ai #aimusic #aivideo #higgsfield #aiart #suno #aiimages
